outcome: Association between dietary shifts and gut microbial communities
Seasonal cycling of gut microbial communities
Distinctive microbial patterns in elderly gut microbial communities
cohort: Infants, Chinese travelers, Hadza hunter-gatherers, and elderly individuals
finding: The microDELTA computational approach effectively tracks longitudinal changes in human gut microbial communities, revealing associations with factors such as delivery mode, dietary shifts, and age.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was found to influence infant gut microbial communities.
